actionable_sentences: The API requires an appointment_id parameter of type string to uniquely identify the existing appointment being modified.
The API requires a new_appointment_date parameter formatted as YYYY-MM-DD to specify the rescheduled appointment date.
The API requires a new_appointment_doctor parameter of type string to specify the doctor assigned to the newly scheduled appointment.
lifted_nl: De ModifyRegistration operatie vereist een appointment_id parameter van type string om de bestaande bezoeksbeurt uniek te identificeren.
De ModifyRegistration operatie vereist een new_appointment_date parameter geformat als YYYY-MM-DD om de herplannenbezoekst te specificeren.
De ModifyRegistration operatie vereist een new_appointment_doctor parameter van type string om de arts toe te wijzen die voor de nieuw geplande bezoekst wordt aangesteld.
operations.LABEL: FUNCTIONAL_SPEC
operations.Precondition: appointment_id is a non-empty string, new_appointment_date matches the pattern \d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}, and new_appointment_doctor is a non-empty string.
operations.Function: modify_registration(appointment_id: str, new_appointment_date: str, new_appointment_doctor: str) -> str
operations.Postcondition: The API returns a status string indicating the success or failure of the modification operation.
assumptions: The appointment_id corresponds to an existing appointment in the system.
The new_appointment_date is a valid calendar date in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).
The new_appointment_doctor is a non-empty string representing a valid medical professional identifier.
invariants: If the operation succeeds, the appointment record is updated with the new date and doctor values.
The original appointment_id remains associated with the updated appointment record.
